requirements.text: Compact lightweight circular enclosure within the specified envelope.

provenance.statement: Existing valve approximately 130 mm diameter and 35 mm projection; maximum OD approximately 230 mm; preferred 210–215 mm OD and 80–90 mm projection.

questions.criterion: Declared dimensions remain within requested limits.
Physical mass and existing attachment capacity are acceptable.

acceptance_criteria: Maximum 50 mm extra radius; approximately 230 mm maximum OD.

requirements.text: Preserve the original annular air opening and avoid narrow added passages.

provenance.statement: Original valve and airflow gap must remain unobstructed; check the entire path, initially aim for 80–100 cm² outlets; effective valve area unknown.

questions.criterion: For an approximate 20–35 mm emission band, nominal CAD clears valve and 12 mm annular band; projected exits and added full-flow section screen ≥80 cm².
Measured valve opening is unobstructed and installed flow remains acceptable.

acceptance_criteria: No obstruction of original valve or airflow gap.

requirements.text: Removable non-destructive attachment to a stationary rim, preserving valve adjustment.

provenance.statement: Never grip the disc; mounting surface and rim not measured; keep diameter, clearance and engagement parametric; do not overload attachment.

questions.criterion: Measured stationary-rim fit, retention, attachment capacity and adjustment remain acceptable.

requirements.text: Solid front shield and broad rounded peripheral windows without an extra baffle.

provenance.statement: Shield direct forward radiation; 6–8 broad rounded windows; smooth internal transitions; no additional internal baffle in V1.

questions.criterion: Forward disc footprint has a solid shield; eight rounded peripheral windows, no internal baffle.

requirements.text: PETG FDM manufacture, preferably one support-free part with front against the bed.

provenance.statement: Shell 2.0–2.4 mm, front 2.4–3.0 mm; avoid unsupported bridges and evaluate taper, window tops, weight and stiffness.

questions.criterion: Nominal thicknesses and manufacturing geometry follow recorded FDM plan.
Actual PETG part prints without unacceptable sag, warp or separation.

requirements.text: Reduce perceived noise while retaining useful airflow, cleanability and stable quiet structure.

provenance.statement: No guaranteed silencing; no assumption of broadband volume attenuation; avoid whistles, rattles, debris traps and a flexible vibrating front.

questions.criterion: Matched-condition physical test shows useful noise reduction without excessive ventilation loss.
Installed part remains secure, cleanable and free of rattle, panel resonance and condensation traps.
